title: Huntik Foundation
summary: The Huntik Foundation is a loosely organized confederation of philanthropists, adventurers, and historians, dedicated to protecting history and exploring ancient secrets. Understanding the importance of preserving forgotten traditions and cultures, the Foundation's goal is to uncover the lost Titans so as to prevent them from falling into the hands of evil, and to defend the world against the evil machinations of Seekers such as the Organization and the Blood Spiral.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Image caption: A 1900s painting showing the meeting of the first Huntik Council

The Huntik Foundation was created early in the 20th century by a group of like minded Seekers who wanted to learn the secrets of the Titans. [Huntik.com] The first Huntik Foundation Council was established at some point after 1959, to deliberate plans and missions. It consisted of seven members, including Eathon Lambert. A painting of the first meeting was hung on the wall of the Huntik Italian HQ. [The Secret of Two Generations] The Huntik Council eventually became based at Huntik International HQ in Manhattan, New York, while maintaining additional operational bases throughout the world. [Coming of Age]

When the Organization revealed itself in 1959, the Foundation recognised the threat it posed to the world. They strove to uncover the lost Titans before they could be discovered and used for evil by the Professor and his followers. [The Secret of Two Generations]

At some point, the Foundation was successfully infiltrated by the Organization, with information on the Prague Huntik Hotel somehow being passed onto DeFoe's Suits. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies] The double agent was revealed to be Zhalia Moon, who had been raised by the Organization scientist, Klaus. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs] However, Zhalia repented for her betrayal and was made an official member by Metz after helping the Foundation obtain the Ring of Behemoth, the Legendary Titan of Body. [Ladies' Choice]

The Foundation were shocked by the revelation that the Professor was, in fact, Simon Judeau, and had once been a member of the Huntik Foundation. [The Secret of Two Generations] The Foundation were officially against Dante Vale's team travelling to the Professor's castle due to the danger and recklessness of the mission, but did not stand in their way. [The Divine Comedy] The Huntik team, in turn, succeeded in defeating the Professor for good. [The Mission] Despite this, the threat of the Organization continued to trouble the Foundation, with the rise of Mr. Wilder who attacked their base in Tower of Nostradamus. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

When the Blood Spiral revealed itself to the world, the Foundation called an emergency council meeting to respond how to deal with this extremely dangerous new threat. [Den vs Harrison] Allied with the Casterwill family, the Foundation sent Dante Vale's team to rescue Focauld Casterwill from the Cloisters and to activate the Blue Star to call the Casterwills out of hiding. [The Casterwill Connection] [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

On the longest night of the year, the Huntik Foundation members travelled on Scramjets to the Spiral Mark to launch an assault on the Blood Spiral Base. [Lok and the Betrayer] Eventually, after a gruelling final battle, the Huntik Foundation succeeded in defeating the Blood Spiral once and for all. [Dante's Return]

Three months after the defeat of the Betrayer, Dante Vale officially joined the Huntik Council with Lok Lambert becoming the new leader of the Foundation's number one team. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Members
sections.wikitext: The Foundation is made up many different [[Seeker]]s and Seeker teams. Among the best Seekers in the Huntik Foundation, [[Dante Vale]] is officially ranked number one, with [[Montehue]] ranked second. {{Source|The Legacy of Thor}} A typical Foundation operative is smart, spunky, and curious. He or she has a nose for a mystery and a keen sense of justice. Foundation operatives value teammates and work together in order to make the world a better place. Some members however prefer to remain out of the field. These operatives are usually profilers who remain at safe houses and research new ways to stop the Organization. {{Source|Divide and Conquer}}
